title: Explicit mixed-neighborhood boundary of the product shrink grid
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring and d1,d2 interchange diagrams for f:X→Y, g:Y→Z [def-pur-etale-graph-interchange-data]. Select one side b. Write barF,barG,barH,E,K,R,N for its explicit ambient neighborhoods and maps [lem-pur-etale-graph-product-ambient-pasting], and F,G,H,E0,K0,R0 for the product supports [lem-pur-etale-graph-product-geometry]. Let vf,vg,vh be the canonical support inclusions. Construct n:V0→N as the pullback lift with ambient projection K0 and selected V-coordinate. Then n K=K0, vh E=E0 n, n R=R0 vg, productBV n=BV, and vf BW=productBW vh. In particular n is open. Put F0bar=R(barH.a) J(E) R(R), F0=R(H.a) J(E0) R(R0). Define middle:F0bar≅F0 J(vg) by the inverse composite graph triangle R(barH.a)→R(H.a) J(vh), open composition across vh E=E0 n, and the inverse normalized exchange for the square (n,R0,R,vg). Define middleBoundary:F0bar J(barG.e) R(barG.p)≅F0 J(G.e) R(G.p) by whiskering middle and composing the last opens via vg barG.e=G.e. Define liftBoundary and productLiftBoundary to be the supplied ambient and product inverse-B exchanges, with their associator and terminal suffix. Define inputBoundary as sourceShrink whiskered by barG followed by F whiskered by middleShrink. All these maps are explicit composites, and middleBoundary uses neither B exchange nor Q exchange.

proof.text: Construct n by the pullback universal property, using the two productK projection equations. Projection gives n K=productK. Since K and productK are open immersions, cancellation proves n open. Compose vh E and productE n with the monomorphism K; the v_j, E_K and productE_productK equations make the results equal. Compose n R and productR vg with the monomorphism barG.e; n K=productK, v_j and the product Q square give equality. The equation productBV n=BV follows by composition with the monomorphism K. For vf BW=productBW vh, compose with the monomorphism barH.e and use BW_e, vf F.e=productF.e, the product B square, and productE productK=productH.e=vh barH.e.
